report.answer_text:
The exact date of the first performance of *The Taming of the Shrew* isn't known. Scholars think Shakespeare wrote it around 1590–1592.
The earliest recorded performance was on 11 June 1594 at the Newington Butts theatre. Philip Henslowe's diary lists it as "the taming of a shrew". That entry may refer to the anonymous play *The Taming of A Shrew*, which was published in 1594 and is closely related to Shakespeare's version. So it isn't certain that Shakespeare's play was the one performed that day.
Shakespeare's version was first printed in the First Folio in 1623.
